address: Shop 306, 3F, Building A, JFC Center, 1701 Island Ring East Boulevard, Siming, Xiamen, China Mainland
bio: This restaurant focuses on the cuisine found in the catchment area of Jiulong River in the prefecture of Zhangzhou, Fujian. Most of the seafood is sourced from the estuary where it flows into the sea. Bittern tofu simmered with russula mushrooms, clams and dried squid comes in an umami-laden broth. Spicy swimming crab with grated ginger exudes spellbinding aromas. Don’t miss the handmade Xiang Pu cake made with mung bean flour....
